thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE to #oncall - High severity: possible cross-tenant KV read detected in dedicated pool for customer 'VantEdge'. Evidence score: 0.72. Affected pool: dp-us-east-2-12. Alert ID: INC-1768501234
oncall-ryan: Acked. Jumping in.
sre-anya: I'm on metrics. CPU/IO look normal. Which kvcache keyspace is showing cross reads?
csd-lin: VantEdge reported seeing another customer's prompt id in telemetry. They emailed support thread 7921.
eng-runtime-julian: Can you paste the sample log? I want to check routing headers and prefix mapping.
csd-lin: pasted: "request_id=abcd1234 pool=dp-us-east-2-12 prefix=ve-123 model=redwood-embed-v1 kv_key=ctx:prefix:4f3a" then later "ctx:prefix:9b7c" from a different tenant appearing in same response.
security-ops-maya: tagging: likely kv-cache key collision or namespace overlap. First step: isolate VantEdge traffic to a quarantine node.
oncall-ryan: Agreed. We have dedicated pool — can we set a routing rule to pin customer to isolated nodes?
eng-runtime-julian: Yes, we can add a temporary routing override to route ve-* prefixes to dp-quarantine-3. Pushing now.
deploy-bot: deploy started: route-override-ve-1768501234 -> prod-routing (canary 10%)
eng-runtime-julian: Increasing canary to 100% for that prefix. Command:
```
redwoodctl routing override set --pool dp-quarantine-3 --prefix ve-123 --duration 30m --reason "isolation - INC-1768501234"
```
oncall-ryan: Doing live KV eviction on the original node(s) to clear any shared state. Command running:
```
ssh runtime@dp-us-east-2-12 -- sudo /usr/local/bin/kv-evict --keyspace ve-*
```
sre-anya: Running audit query across KV nodes to find keys with non-conforming tenant prefix:
```
redis-cli -h dp-us-east-2-12 --scan | grep -E "^(ve|cust|prefix)-" | awk -F":" '{print $2,$0}'
```
security-ops-maya: Also enable additional logging for routing headers for 20m:
```
redwoodctl logging set --target pool:dp-us-east-2-12 --filter routing_header --level debug --duration 20m
```
csd-lin: VantEdge wants immediate confirmation that their data isn't exposed. Can we confirm no PII present in the leaked snippet? They provided masked snippet.
eng-runtime-julian: From quick check the snippet contains partial customer prompt segments, not raw PII. But we need full artifact to be sure. Requesting full sanitized payload from CS.
solutions-kate: Telling VantEdge we're isolating and performing a targeted audit. ETA 30-45m for initial findings.
oncall-ryan: Found 3 keys on dp-us-east-2-12 that had ambiguous prefixes. Initiating targeted scrub and moving them to quarantined pool. Logs:
```
[1768501248] moved key ctx:prefix:9b7c -> dp-quarantine-3
[1768501253] evicted ctx:prefix:4f3a
```
security-ops-maya: Cross-checking with access logs to see which requests touched those keys. Pulling from s3://audit-logs/2026/03/15/pool-dp-us-east-2-12.log.gz
eng-runtime-julian: Also checking for routing policy regression that could have caused prefix map to collapse. Possible cause: recent autoscaler change that reused instance IDs without clearing key namespace mapping. :thinking_face: 
sre-anya: Metrics show a brief spike in kv-ops at 11:47:30 UTC, correlates with a deploy window 11:47. Rolling back that deploy might help. Should we rollback?
oncall-ryan: Hold - we isolated traffic already; rollback will risk churn. Only rollback if audit shows config txn failed.
security-ops-maya: Confirmed no other customer reads were observed per access log sampling (10k lines). That's encouraging but continue full scan.
csd-lin: VantEdge acknowledged the isolation and asked for a root-cause summary when done. Also wants confirmation their billing/quotas unaffected.
eng-runtime-julian: I'm opening a background job to do a full keyspace diff across dp-us-east-2-12 and dp-quarantine-3 and will upload results to the incident folder.
deploy-bot: deploy finished: route-override-ve-1768501234 -> prod-routing (100%)
oncall-ryan: Good. Set temporary SLA mitigation: route to quarantine + additional logging + targeted scan. Will keep page open until full diff completed.
security-ops-maya: Preliminary RCA hypothesis: key namespace overlap due to a bug in key-prefix normalizer where empty customer-id falls back to global prefix. Patch in review: https://git.redwood/patches/KEyNorm-452
solutions-kate: I'll draft the customer note and include mitigation steps and next steps. csd-lin please review before send.
oncall-ryan: ETA for full diff 90m. If anything with PII surfaces we will escalate to legal. For now marking SEV2. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident INC-1768501234 updated by oncall-ryan: status=mitigating participants=8
sre-anya: leaving a note: saved snapshots of kv state and routing table at s3://incidents/1768501234/snapshots/
csd-lin: Thanks team. Will follow up with customer and update thread.
eng-runtime-julian: After full diff we'll issue a permanent fix and a follow-up deploy to address prefix normalizer.
security-ops-maya: Adding post-mortem owner: eng-runtime-julian, due in 7 days.
oncall-ryan: I'll hand off to next on-call in 45m. @sre-anya take primary during overnight.
sre-anya: Ack, will monitor. If anything new appears ping with @here.
csd-lin: closing customer loop for now, will reopen if they see anomalies.
incident-bot: Incident INC-1768501234 status=mitigated awaiting full audit results
